tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, sheets, form fields and the header, set on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, selected chips, hover rows and quiet panels, set on `surface` or `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, MRP strike-through, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers between rows and card edges. Never the only edge of a form control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and outlined buttons. 3:1 or better against `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Threadhouse indigo. Primary buttons, links, active nav, focus ring and the logo line. Text on it uses `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Fills only: the free-pickup banner, badges, the tag in the logo. Never as text colour on light surfaces. Text on it uses `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with a 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Order status Placed: pill background.

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: Order status Placed: pill text on `status-info-bg`.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Order status Ready for pickup, and low-stock notices: pill background.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Ready for pickup and low stock: text on `status-warning-bg`.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Order status Collected, and in-stock notices: pill background.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Collected and in stock: text on `status-success-bg`.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Order status Not collected, and out-of-stock notices, and form errors: background.

tokens.name: status-danger-text
tokens.usage: Not collected, out of stock and form errors: text on `status-danger-bg`.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Order status Cancelled: pill background.

tokens.name: status-neutral-text
tokens.usage: Cancelled: text on `status-neutral-bg`.

styles.name: label

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, store names under products, timestamps.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Selling price. Set with tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and inputs, gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of the home hero on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, small images.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards, store cards, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, size chips, filter chips.

tokens.usage: Product cards on hover and the sticky mobile reserve bar. Cards at rest use `line` instead.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets such as the store picker.
